description: This file contains the implementation of a web service class 'SugarWebServiceImplv3' for SuiteCRM, extending the base class 'SugarWebServiceImpl'. It provides methods for login, retrieving module info, layouts, available modules, recent views, upcoming activities, module searching, and retrieving related records, thus serving as the Web Service interface for client applications.

classes.name: SugarWebServiceImplv3
classes.description: The implementation class for SuiteCRM v3 web services, providing methods for user authentication, module metadata retrieval, search, and relationship data endpoints.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the helper object for the class.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user with provided credentials and initiates a session, returning session data and user preferences.

methods.name: get_module_fields_md5
methods.description: Returns MD5 hashes of module vardefs, used for client-side caching or validation.

methods.name: get_server_info
methods.description: Returns server version and environment info like flavor, version, and current GMT time.

methods.name: get_module_layout
methods.description: Retrieves layout definitions for specified modules, views, and types, optionally returning MD5 hashes.

methods.name: get_module_layout_md5
methods.description: Returns MD5 hash of the module's layout metadata for cache validation.

methods.name: get_available_modules
methods.description: Returns a list of modules available and accessible to the current user session.

methods.name: get_last_viewed
methods.description: Fetches recently viewed records per module for the current user.

methods.name: get_upcoming_activities
methods.description: Provides a list of upcoming activities such as calls, meetings, and tasks.

methods.name: search_by_module
methods.description: Performs a search across specified modules with given search parameters, returning matching records.

methods.name: get_relationships
methods.description: Retrieves related records for a given module and record ID, including relationship link data.
